descriptive_title: Grade 2 Mathematics: Demonstrations — Standard Units of Measurement (E2.1-E2.4)
short_description: A 5-day Grade 2 unit on standard measurement framed around Roo the Ruler Rabbit and Cal the Calendar Cat. Children explore inverse relationship, cm/m, rulers, and time units.
long_description: Master measurement with Roo and Cal! This 5-day Ontario-aligned Grade 2 unit covers all 4 E2 expectations (E2.1-E2.4). Day 1 explores non-standard units and inverse relationship. Day 2 introduces centimetres and metres with benchmarks. Day 3 measures with rulers (start at zero!). Day 4 introduces time units (seconds, minutes, hours). Day 5 closes with a Measure Marathon Capstone. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a Grade-2 trap: cubes-for-everything, 100 cm = 100 m, off-by-one ruler, wrong-magnitude time, wrong-tool), 5 student worksheets, 12 paper manipulatives, formative + reflection sheets, full assessment suite with 4-row summative rubric, and Junior Measure Maven G2 certificates.
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 2 teachers looking for a fully scaffolded 5-day standard measurement unit (E2.1-E2.4).
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: Hands-on measurement with character-driven detective frame, structured pair work, and Canadian context.
